name: Sherpa Mini
description: The Sherpa Mini is an open source, community-designed compact direct drive extruder from Annex Engineering. It uses a 50:8 gear ratio (6.25:1) with dual drive gears when paired with the recommended LDO 8-tooth NEMA14 motor. Its small size and lightweight design make it well-suited for high-acceleration printers, and the fully open source design has spawned many community remixes and toolhead integrations.
features: Fully open source design (CAD and BOM available)
Wide ecosystem of community toolhead integrations
